en: A multi-view color postcard showing scenic landscapes and lakeside buildings surrounded by coniferous forests and mountains. The top images depict hotels or guesthouses, outdoor terraces with tables and umbrellas, and forested hillsides. The bottom images show a calm lake reflecting autumn-colored trees and mountains, as well as lakeside buildings with arches along the shore. Across the center is a bold printed greeting in Italian mentioning Lago di Cei at 960 meters in Trentino.
